No one is like Prophet Muhammad; No one is better in this Ummah than Prophet Muhammad, but I don't make him God like the Christians do; There is a balance, and that's what Muslims should do: have a balance. Yes, Ali ؓ is respected; – He has his status in Islam, but he's not God – Yeah He doesn't have– I know you don't believe that he's God, he doesn't have all knowledge like some 'Alawis say ('Alawiyyah: a sect of Shi'ism), I'm telling you, Allah سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ (Subhanahu wa ta'ala: Glory to Him, He is far above what they say!) He says in the Quran (Obey Allah..) Chapter 4 (Annisa'), verse 59, if you want to read He tells us (Obey Allah..) Let's read it from the Quran so we can know what we should do. Allah tells us the Guidance of what we should do, right? The Quran is Guidance. OK, (O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you. And if you disagree over anything, refer it to Allah and the Messenger if you should believe.) If you believe in the last day, refer it to Allah and the Messenger. That is the best way and the best result. If we have a disagreement with anyone about anything in Islam, then we go back to Allah, we go back to the Prophet Muhammadﷺ. We see that Allah told us to obey and follow the Prophet Yes, behave like the righteous Companions, behave like them, be like them, But don't mention their name when you pray, When you make دُعاء (Du'a: calling upon Allah). Don't seek aid from them; don't say "Ali, help me, give me.." – We do! – Yes, I know you do. That's what I'm saying Ok, Allah Subhanahu wa ta'ala says (Albaqara2:186) وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ (If My servants ask you about Me..) – Are you from the servants of Allah? – Yeah We are servants of Allah, isn't it? He says, (if My servants), which is us, you say I'm a Muslim Allah says, (if My servants ask you about Me, say, "I am near, I answer the call of the person who prays) Who answers? Allah answers! I don't call Ali, I don't call Omar. Even Prophet Muhammad, you don't go to his grave and ask him for help Allahﷻ says in the Quran (Fatir35:14) إِن تَدۡعُوهُمۡ لَا یَسۡمَعُوا۟ دُعَاۤءَكُمۡ وَلَوۡ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسۡتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمۡۖ وَیَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِیَـٰمَةِ یَكۡفُرُونَ بِشِرۡكِكُمۡۚ (If you call upon them –the dead or these people, righteous people that you call upon them– they will not hear your Du'a) (And if they heard, they cannot respond to you) (And on the Day of Judgment, they will disbelieve in your Shirk) –associating your partners with Allah– وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ (And no one can tell you more than Allah) This is the Quran, but it's not my word. If the Prophet cannot make the dead hear, Can we make the dead hear? When you, my brother, you pray in English, when you pray to Ali in English, did Ali speak English in his life? – It's Turkish because I'm Turkish – OK, when you pray in Turkish, does Ali understand Turkish? (Almaida5:104) He says (they said that's what we found our forefathers upon). Allah says (what if your forefathers were not guided? What if they didn't know?) Chapter:5, Verse:104; He says (what if your forefathers didn't know? What if they were not guided?) How do you just follow what your forefathers told you? It's not a deen – It's a sect That's why I said is a sect. I didn't say a deen. I said it's a sect. – No, I'll give you an example – Yeah, of course – if you have all works then innit, you are a Sunni, innit? – No, a Muslim.. OK! You will tell him that! I'm telling you the same thing Akhi (My brother), your forefathers are not going to benefit you. What we mean by respect is allowing you to practise your religion But.. Listen my brother, just listen to this key point. Only Allah can give you these things Just stay on that. That's the Truth, man. Stay on that. Don't go here and there, man.
